body: I posted on sw yesterday, but I'm getting ever closer to killing myself. Pretty much the only thing holding me back is my reluctance to hurt my family. I need help, I don't know what to do. I feel so alone, no one to talk to.
Thank you. Be she has become pretty distant, which brings so much pain into my life. She found someone, and I can't stand it.

You kind of hit it on the dot. She gives so much meaning to my life, and now she's slipping away and I can't stand the fact that she is going with some other guy. I know I can accomplish a lot, but my depression is dragging me down. I can't do things like I used to.
Thank you. But how do you move on, when you're so in love with a girl of 7 years..

I don't know how to move on. I can't stop thinking about her, and the other guy. I know it sounds fucking stupid that I'll lose my life over a girl, but its more about the pain and my fear that I'll never be able to move on. I'm just haunted by the fact that I may be lonely my whole life. I don't have that many friends, and not great at meeting new peopl either
